today_in_history_posts.title: Splice Pinning Prevention w/o Anchors
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Anchor outputs were introduced to mitigate junk pinning in lightning transactions.
- Splice transactions need specific witness scripts to counteract bulk pinning attacks.
- Splicing protocol adjustments ensure all outputs comply with new security protocols.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Passive investment strategies involve little to no active management of assets.  - Active investments require direct involvement and management to generate profits.  - The article suggests central banks could stabilize economies using deflationary currencies.
